description: Finds up to pk spectral peaks in each window (searching the formant envelope extracted per -f/-p) and refocuses the window's energy through peak-centred filters of bandwidth bw octaves - imposing the spectral content of the peaks onto the whole sound. Exactly one of the two formant-extraction flags (-f linear-frequency or -p pitchwise bands) is required, and it must precede the pk/bw positionals (the engine's declaration order handles this). Static duration (2.0230 s from a 2.023 s analysis, 1.5209 from 1.5209), fully deterministic (runs 1.3 s apart byte-identical). -f and -p renders verified distinct; -i (quicksearch), -b/-t (search limits) and -s (stability averaging) each change the render. Operates on PVOC analysis files (.ana).
musical_use: A self-filtering resonator: the sound is filtered through its own most prominent frequencies, hardening its resonances and thinning everything else - vowels become more vowel-like, bells more bell-like, noise acquires pitch centres. pk sets how many resonances survive (1-3 = drone/chord-like reduction, 16 = subtle reinforcement); bw sets how surgical the filters are (near the 1/12-octave minimum they ring like a filter bank, wide values just tilt the spectrum - SoundThread's default 0.3 sits usefully between). Restrict the peak search with -b/-t to force the focus into a register (e.g. -b500 -t3000 keeps it in the formant band); ramp bw with a breakpoint file to travel from diffuse to ringing over the file. Follow with focus accu or stretch time for slowly evolving resonant washes.

fchans.description: Extract the formant envelope linear frequency-wise, 1 point per N equally-spaced channels. Mutually exclusive with pbands - supply exactly one of the two. File-dependent ceiling ('-f1000' refused verbatim: 'ERROR: Too many formant_bands requested: max for this file is 256' on a default 44.1 kHz analysis); -f0 crashes with 'ERROR: INTERNAL ERROR: (Bug?) / ERROR: Formant array too small: set_specenv_frqs()' - keep it >= 1. Scalar only (a breakpoint file fails with 'Cannot read count of formant_bands.').

pbands.description: Extract the formant envelope pitchwise, N equally-spaced pitch-bands per octave (SoundThread's choice, default 7, slider 1-12). File-dependent ceiling ('-p13' refused verbatim: 'ERROR: Too many formant_bands requested: max for this file is 12'); -p0 is accepted (exit 0, distinct render) but its meaning is undocumented - stay at 1-12. Mutually exclusive with fchans. Scalar only (a breakpoint file fails with 'Cannot read count of formant_bands.').

quicksearch.description: Quicksearch for formants (faster, less accurate). Verified live: changes the render.

pk.description: Maximum number of spectral peaks to find and refocus onto. CDP-enforced 1 to 16 (0 and 17 refused verbatim: 'Parameter[1] Value (17.000000) out of range (1.000000 to 16.000000)'). Breakpoint file refused ('Cannot read parameter 1 [...]: brkpnt_files not permitted.').

bw.description: Bandwidth of the peak-centred filters in octaves. CDP-enforced 0.083333 (= 1/12 octave, a semitone) to 10 (0 and 12 refused verbatim: 'Parameter[2] Value (0.000000) out of range (0.083333 to 10.000000)') - SoundThread's 0.1 floor is an advisory subset. May vary over time via a breakpoint file (verified: a 0.1-to-6 ramp differs from both scalar-endpoint renders).

bt.description: Bottom frequency of the peak search (default: whole spectrum). CDP-enforced 5 to Nyquist ('-b-5' refused verbatim: 'Parameter[3] Value (-5.000000) out of range (5.000000 to 22050.000000)'; ceiling is srate-dependent). May vary over time via a breakpoint file (verified: a 100-to-2000 ramp differs from both scalar-endpoint renders).

tp.description: Top frequency of the peak search (default: whole spectrum). CDP-enforced 5 to Nyquist ('-t30000' refused verbatim, srate-dependent ceiling). Supplying bt > tp is silently swapped ('-b3000 -t500' renders byte-identical to '-b500 -t3000' - verified). May vary over time via a breakpoint file (verified: a 1000-to-8000 ramp differs from both scalar-endpoint renders).

stable.description: Number of windows over which peaks are averaged to retain only time-STABLE peaks. CDP-enforced 2 to 4097 ('-s1' and '-s4098' refused verbatim: 'Parameter[5] Value (1.000000) out of range (2.000000 to 4097.000000)'). Default 9 - pinned by rendered equivalence: the flag-less run is byte-identical to '-s9', so stability averaging is ALWAYS on; -s only changes the window count ('-s100' renders differently). Breakpoint file refused ('Cannot read parameter 5 [...]: brkpnt_files not permitted.').

examples.description: SoundThread's defaults: 7 pitch-bands, all 16 peaks, moderately narrow filters.
examples.expected_use: The source filtered through its own prominent frequencies - resonances harden, inter-peak material thins.

examples.description: Drone reduction: three stable peaks, semitone-wide filters, search confined to 200-3000 Hz.
examples.expected_use: A ringing three-note spectral skeleton of the source, steady enough to use as a chordal drone.

known_issues: Exactly one of fchans (-f) or pbands (-p) must be supplied AND it must come before the pk/bw positionals: with neither (or with the flag placed after the positionals) CDP refuses with 'Formant parameter missing on cmdline.' (exit 255, no ERROR prefix); with both, 'ERROR: Cannot read parameter 1 [-f4]' - the second flag is mis-parsed as pk. Same mechanism as strange glis.

The -f/-p ceilings are data-checked per file, not range-checked: 'Too many formant_bands requested: max for this file is 12' (-p) / 'max for this file is 256' (-f) on a default 1024-point 44.1 kHz analysis. -f0 is an INTERNAL ERROR crash; -p0 runs but is undocumented.
Stability averaging is always active with a default of 9 windows (flag-less byte-identical to -s9, verified); -s does not toggle the feature, it resizes it.
bt/tp reversed bounds are silently swapped (byte-identical renders, verified) - no warning is printed.
wav input refused: 'Application doesn't work with this type of infile.' - convert with pvoc anal first (the engine does this automatically).
